message.breeder_scarecrow.station_placed: Ranch station placed, working a radius of %s blocks
message.breeder_scarecrow.worker_recalle: Called the rancher back to the station
message.breeder_scarecrow.worker_no_room: No room to summon a rancher - clear a space beside the station
message.breeder_scarecrow.highlight_off: Work area highlight: only while holding a ranch station
config.breeder_scarecrow.title: Breeder Scarecrow
config.breeder_scarecrow.enable_breeding: Whether the rancher feeds animals to breed them. Independent of slaughtering, so either job can run on its own.
config.breeder_scarecrow.require_feed_it:
On: feed has to be placed in the station by hand and one item is spent per animal.
Off: animals breed for free and no feed is needed.
config.breeder_scarecrow.breed_interval_: How long the rancher waits after feeding one animal before feeding another. 20 ticks is one second.
config.breeder_scarecrow.max_animals_per: Breeding of a species pauses once this many of them are inside the area, babies included.
config.breeder_scarecrow.feed_babies.too: Also feed babies to speed up their growth. This eats through feed quickly.
config.breeder_scarecrow.play_feed_sound: Play the eating sound every time an animal is fed. The happy particles show up either way.
Whether the rancher slaughters surplus animals. Independent of breeding, so either job can run on its own.
config.breeder_scarecrow.keep_adults_per: Adults of a species the rancher keeps. Anything above this gets slaughtered. Babies are never slaughtered, and neither are tamed or named animals.
config.breeder_scarecrow.cull_interval_t: How long the rancher waits after finishing one animal off before starting on the next.
config.breeder_scarecrow.instant_kill.to:
On: one blow finishes an animal off whatever the rancher is holding.
Off: it hits for its weapon's damage and keeps swinging until the animal drops. Drops are the same either way.
config.breeder_scarecrow.enable_shearing: The rancher carries its own shears, so there is nothing to stock. Wool lands on the ground and the sweep that always follows a harvest picks it up. Named and tamed animals are left alone.
The rancher carries its own bucket, so there is nothing to stock. Off by default: a milk bucket does not stack, so every cow milked costs a whole slot and fills a station of 27 in a few rounds.
config.breeder_scarecrow.work_radius.too: How far the work area reaches out from the station. Animals and drops outside it are ignored.
config.breeder_scarecrow.work_height.too: How far the work area reaches above and below the station, so animals on a slope still count.
config.breeder_scarecrow.work_interval_t: How often the rancher looks around for its next job while idle.
config.breeder_scarecrow.worker_respawn_: How long the station waits before summoning a replacement for a rancher that died or went missing.
config.breeder_scarecrow.open_fence_gate: Let the rancher open a fence gate that is in its way and shut it again once through, so the herd stays put. Off: gates count as solid wall, same as for any other mob.
Let the rancher shoulder animals in front of it out of the way while walking, instead of pathing the long way round or giving up. Animals are only nudged sideways, never through a gateway, and players are left alone.
config.breeder_scarecrow.invulnerable.to:
On: nothing can hurt the rancher, so a creeper wandering past cannot cost you the pack it was carrying.
Off: it takes damage like any other mob, and the station summons a replacement when it dies. /kill works either way.
config.breeder_scarecrow.highlight_alway:
On: the work area highlight is always visible.
Off: it only shows while holding a ranch station. The hotkey toggles this at any time.
config.breeder_scarecrow.show_worker_sta: Print what the rancher is doing over its head: current job, distance to its target, and why it is standing still. Useful for working out where a ranch is stuck.
